question: Using Supabase, what was Vertex Logistics' MRR in March 2026?
answer_text:
Annual billing at 9600 USD, active throughout March 2026 (started 2026-01-01, not ended). MRR = 9600 / 12 = 800.

Vertex Logistics (ACC-1001) has one subscription, SUB-7001, on the Enterprise plan. It's billed annually at 9,600 USD and was active in March 2026. Normalizing the annual amount to a monthly figure gives 9,600 / 12 = 800.

ANSWER: 800
